title: Understanding Regularization
text: When we apply regularization, we are essentially adding a penalty to the size of the coefficients in our model. As the regularization parameter lambda increases, this penalty becomes more significant. Think about what happens to the coefficients when the penalty is very large.

title: Effect of Large Lambda
text: Consider the effect of a very large lambda on the coefficients of the model. If lambda is extremely large, the penalty term dominates the optimization process. What does this imply about the values of the coefficients?

title: Predictions with Large Lambda
text: As lambda approaches positive $$\infty$$, what happens to the predictions of the model?
choices: the mean of the true $$y$$ values
